description: A recent Gallup poll says only 10% of Americans approve of Congress. That’s only 1% above the all-time low of 9% (in November of 2013). Gallup has measured approval since 1974, when approval was at 30%.Now 86% disapprove of Congress.That is staggering, even if you consider the average approval over the years is only 28% and disapproval is 65%.
